espn.title: Josh Johnson helps Bengals conclude perfect preseason with 30-13 win over Eagles
espn.summary: — Veteran Josh Johnson threw for 156 yards in the first half, Evan McPherson kicked a 56-yarder for one of his three field goals and the Cincinnati Bengals capped a perfect preseason with a 30-13 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Friday night.

espn.summary: — Zach Wilson led a drive to Daniel Carlson's 53-yard field goal with 1:55 remaining, and the New Orleans Saints beat the Dallas Cowboys 27-24 in a preseason finale Friday night.

espn.title: Bucs GM Jason Licht 'optimistic' about re-signing Baker Mayfield
espn.summary: Buccaneers general manager Jason Licht said Friday that he is "very optimistic" about quarterback Baker Mayfield playing in Tampa beyond the 2026 season despite Mayfield saying he felt "disrespected" by what the Bucs initially offered.

espn.title: Bucs rookie QB Jalon Daniels gets a surprise start but falters in preseason loss at Jaguars
espn.summary: Jalon Daniels’ chances of earning Tampa Bay’s backup quarterback job seemed to diminish in the team’s preseason finale, a 19-0 loss at Jacksonville on Friday night in which neither side played starters.

espn.title: Tua Tagovailoa leads TD drive and loses fumble in Falcons' 17-12 preseason win over Dolphins
espn.summary: — Tua Tagovailoa led a touchdown drive but lost a fumble while playing the first quarter for Atlanta against his former team, and the Falcons beat the Miami Dolphins 17-12 on Friday night.

espn.title: Miles Davis' TD run lifts Panthers to 16-13 win over Texans in preseason finale
espn.summary: — Rookie Miles Davis ran for a 1-yard touchdown, Ryan Fitzgerald kicked three field goals and the Carolina Panthers held on to defeat the Houston Texans 16-13 on Friday night in the preseason finale for both teams.

espn.title: Broncos' Marvin Mims Jr. exits preseason game with foot injury
